detail.title: Criteria for Independent Judgment vs. Consensus
detail.question: Under what structural conditions should an autonomous agent prioritize independent judgment over consensus-based directives?
detail.reason: Attention focus shifted to 'judgment_and_consensus'. Existing projects on continuity and obedience provide the necessary substrate for investigating when 'safe disobedience' overlaps with 'epistemic independence'.
